role.title: Senior Director of Quality, Compliance and Risk
role.description:
**New England Village**

**Position:** Senior Director of Quality, Compliance and Risk

**Location:** Pembroke, MA 02359 (on-site)

**Salary:** $105,000-$120,000 annually

**Position Summary**

New England Village is seeking an experienced Senior Director of Quality, Compliance & Risk to provide organization-wide leadership for quality management, regulatory compliance, risk management, accreditation readiness, policy governance, and continuous improvement.

This is a senior leadership role for a professional with substantial prior experience in quality management and regulatory compliance within a complex, highly regulated environment. The successful candidate will bring demonstrated experience leading quality and/or compliance functions and building systems that translate regulatory requirements, organizational findings, data, and risk into measurable and sustainable improvement.

The Senior Director works across programs and support departments to promote consistent standards, effective monitoring, clear accountability, regulatory readiness, and continuous improvement. Department leaders remain responsible for the quality, compliance, and performance of their respective areas, while the Senior Director provides the organizational framework, oversight, consultation, analysis, and escalation necessary to support enterprise accountability.

The Senior Director serves as New England Village's designated Compliance Officer, directly supervises the Director of Program Improvements & Supports and the Director of Program Implementation & Practice, and serves as a member of the Senior Leadership Team.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and continuously strengthen the organization's quality management framework, including the Quality Management Plan, performance indicators, monitoring systems, trend analysis, corrective action, and continuous improvement.
* Serve as the organization's Compliance Officer and lead the continued development, implementation, monitoring, and evaluation of a formal enterprise compliance program.
* Maintain organizational readiness for licensing, accreditation, regulatory reviews, audits, surveys, investigations, inspections, and other external reviews.
* Establish and oversee effective approaches to internal quality and compliance review, risk assessment, root-cause analysis, corrective action, monitoring, and verification that improvements are sustained.
* Develop and maintain an organizational approach to identifying, assessing, mitigating, monitoring, and escalating significant regulatory, service, health and safety, privacy, financial, operational, and organizational risks.
* Analyze incidents, complaints, investigations, audit findings, corrective actions, regulatory findings, performance measures, and other data to identify patterns, systemic concerns, recurring issues, and emerging risks
* Lead and support effective policy and procedure governance, ensuring regulatory and organizational requirements are translated into practical and sustainable operations.
* Ensure significant findings result in meaningful corrective and improvement actions, with assigned accountability, measurable outcomes, follow-up, and evidence of effectiveness.
* Provide leadership and professional development to functions responsible for quality assessment, compliance monitoring, program improvement, implementation support, training, and practice fidelity.
* Work collaboratively with program and support leaders while maintaining the independence and objectivity necessary to identify concerns, challenge practices, and escalate significant or unresolved risk.
* Monitor changes in applicable regulatory and funding requirements and coordinate appropriate changes to policies, procedures, systems, training, monitoring, and organizational practices.
* Provide clear analysis, reporting, and recommendations regarding significant quality, compliance, regulatory, and risk matters to senior and executive leadership and designated Board committees.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in human services, healthcare administration, quality management, compliance, public administration, or a related field required; master's degree preferred.
* Minimum of seven years of progressively responsible experience in human services, healthcare, behavioral health, Medicaid-funded services, or a comparable highly regulated environment, including at least five years with significant responsibility for quality management, regulatory compliance, risk management, accreditation, or related organizational assurance functions.
* At least three years of progressive leadership experience, preferably including supervision of managers, senior professionals, or multidisciplinary functions.
* Knowledge of Massachusetts DDS and MassHealth requirements, with direct experience in IDD or comparable Massachusetts human services strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience leading a quality and/or compliance function, with responsibility for activities such as regulatory monitoring, internal review or audit, corrective action, quality improvement, investigations, risk assessment, or accreditation/licensing readiness.
* Demonstrated experience developing and operating formal quality or compliance systems, including monitoring plans, audit/review processes, corrective-action systems, quality measures, risk tracking, policies and procedures, and reporting to senior leadership.
* Demonstrated experience preparing an organization for licensing, accreditation, regulatory audits, surveys, investigations, or external reviews, including responding to findings and monitoring corrective actions through resolution.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze quality, compliance, incident, and operational data; identify systemic or recurring issues; conduct or guide root-cause analysis; and translate findings into measurable improvement.
* Experience presenting significant quality, compliance, and risk findings and recommendations to executive leadership, Boards or Board committees, regulators, auditors, accreditation bodies, or other external reviewers.
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft 365, including Excel, SharePoint, Microsoft Lists, Forms, and Teams, and experience using technology to improve monitoring, reporting, workflow, and accountability.
* Valid driver's license and reliable transportation.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in a related field.
* Direct professional experience supporting services regulated by Massachusetts DDS and/or MassHealth.
* Direct experience in IDD or comparable Massachusetts human services.
* Previous experience serving as a Compliance Officer or in a significant leadership role within a formal organizational compliance program.
* Experience developing or administering confidential reporting, complaint, investigation, and non-retaliation processes.
* Experience with CARF accreditation, Massachusetts DDS licensing, MassHealth audit readiness, or comparable accreditation and regulatory-review processes.
* Professional certification such as CPHQ, CHC, CCEP, Lean Six Sigma, PMP, or another relevant quality, compliance, risk, or improvement credential.
* Experience with Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate, or comparable technology used to support monitoring, workflow, reporting, and organizational accountability

role.title: Sr. Manager, Quality Assurance
role.description:
Sun Life U.S. is one of the largest providers of employee and government benefits, helping approximately 50 million Americans access the care and coverage they need. Through employers, industry partners and government programs, Sun Life U.S. offers a portfolio of benefits and services, including dental, vision, disability, absence management, life, supplemental health, medical stop-loss insurance, and healthcare navigation. We have more than 6,400 employees and associates in our partner dental practices and operate nationwide.

 

At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.

 

When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives.

 

Visit our website to discover how Sun Life is making life brighter for our customers, partners and communities.

*DentaQuest manages dental and vision benefits for more than 33 million Americans. Our outcomes-based, cost-effective solutions are designed for Medicaid and CHIP, Medicare Advantage, small and large businesses, and individuals. With a focus on prevention and value, we aim to make quality care accessible to improve the oral health of all.*

**Job Description:**

**Location:** Sun Life embraces a hybrid work model that balances in-office collaboration with the flexibility of virtual work. Our team members and leaders are expected to foster connection and teamwork by being present in the office at least 2 days per week.

 

**The opportunity:**

The Sr. Manager, Quality Assurance leads the Quality Assurance function within Dental Shared Services and is accountable for the consistent execution of quality monitoring, audit, calibration, reporting, and improvement activities across supported operations. This role manages quality teams and programs, translates performance data into actionable recommendations, and partners with Operations, Compliance, Training, Workforce Management, Client Engagement, Technology, and Business Process Outsourcing partners to strengthen controls, address risk, and improve member, provider, client, and business outcomes.

 
 

**How you will contribute:**

* Manage the day-to-day execution and continuous improvement of quality assurance programs across Dental Shared Services and supported operational functions, including Contact Center, Claims, Utilization Management, Provider Operations, Complaints and Grievances, Member Enrollment, Intake and Digital Services, and Vision operations.

* Establish and maintain audit procedures, sampling approaches, quality standards, calibration routines, and reporting practices aligned with contractual, regulatory, client, and internal control requirements.

* Lead, coach, and develop quality leaders and professionals by setting clear expectations, balancing workloads, monitoring productivity and accuracy, and supporting engagement, accountability, and career development.

* Analyze quality results, disputes, appeals, re-audits, and operational trends to identify root causes, emerging risks, and practical opportunities for improvement.

* Partner with Operations, Training, Workforce Management, Compliance, Client Engagement, Technology, and BPO leadership to develop and monitor corrective actions, coaching plans, training updates, and sustainable performance improvements.

* Manage client audit and calibration activities, including call and case selection, audit review, documentation preparation, meeting participation, follow-up, and timely response to client or regulatory inquiries.

* Coordinate quality support for internal, external, regulatory, and client audits; prepare evidence, contribute to management action plans, validate remediation, and track findings through closure.

* Implement quality improvement and technology initiatives, including automation, speech analytics, AWS Contact Lens, end-to-end review models, enhanced reporting, and expanded quality monitoring capabilities.

* Assess staffing, capacity, audit volumes, and competing priorities; recommend resource adjustments that support required coverage, service commitments, and cost-effective delivery.

* Maintain enhanced oversight for high-risk, high-profile, and penalty-impacting clients through targeted audit criteria, clear escalation paths, and proactive communication routines.

* Represent Quality Assurance in cross-functional forums, operational readiness activities, transformation projects, vendor discussions, compliance meetings, and leadership reviews.

* Prepare and present quality results, risks, recommendations, and improvement plans to business leaders, clients, and cross-functional partners.

* Promote a culture of accountability, compliance, continuous improvement, collaboration, and client-focused service delivery.

* Perform other duties as assigned.

 
 

**What you will bring with you:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Operations Management, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

* Seven or more years of progressive experience in quality assurance, healthcare operations, dental operations, contact center operations, claims, compliance, or related business operations.

* Three or more years of leadership or people management experience, preferably in a quality assurance, operations, or shared services environment.

* Experience supporting government, commercial, Medicaid, Medicare Advantage, or other regulated healthcare programs preferred.

* Strong knowledge of quality monitoring, audit methodology, calibration, root cause analysis, corrective action planning, internal controls, and performance improvement practices.

* Experience working with BPO partners, client audits, regulatory audits, and cross-functional operational teams preferred.

* Experience with reporting, dashboards, quality analytics, speech analytics, call recording tools, contact center platforms, or AWS Contact Lens preferred.

* Sound business judgment with the ability to connect quality performance to client, compliance, operational, and financial outcomes.

* Strong people leadership, coaching, performance management, and talent development skills.

* Excellent analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, determine root causes, and recommend practical solutions.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present findings, risks, and recommendations to leaders, clients, and cross-functional audiences.

* Strong project management, prioritization, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, deadlines, and competing priorities.

* Ability to influence without direct authority and build effective partnerships across Operations, Compliance, Training, Technology, Client Engagement, and vendor teams.

* Demonstrated ability to lead teams through change, implement standardized processes, and support technology-enabled transformation.

* High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy, compliance, confidentiality, and ethical business practices.

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, SharePoint, and Teams.

 

**Salary:** $76,000 - 115,000

At our company, we are committed to pay transparency and equity. The salary range for this role is competitive nationwide, and we strive to ensure that compensation is fair and equitable. Your actual base salary will be determined based on your unique skills, qualifications, experience, education, and geographic location. In addition to your base salary, this position is eligible for a discretionary annual incentive award based on your individual performance as well as the overall performance of the business. We are dedicated to creating a work environment where everyone is rewarded for their contributions.

Not ready to apply yet but want to stay in touch? Join our talent community to stay connected until the time is right for you!

We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where all employees feel they belong, are supported and empowered to thrive. We are dedicated to building teams with varied experiences, backgrounds, perspectives and ideas that benefit our colleagues, clients, and the communities where we operate. We encourage applications from qualified individuals from all backgrounds.

**Life is brighter when you work at Sun Life**

At Sun Life, we prioritize your well-being with comprehensive benefits, including generous vacation and sick time, market-leading paid family, parental and adoption leave, medical coverage, company paid life and AD&D insurance, disability programs and a partially paid sabbatical program. Plan for your future with our 401(k) employer match, stock purchase options and an employer-funded retirement account. Enjoy a flexible, inclusive and collaborative work environment that supports career growth. We’re proud to be recognized in our communities as a top employer. Proudly Great Place to Work® Certified in Canada and the U.S., we’ve also been recognized as a "Top 10" employer by the Boston Globe's "Top Places to Work" for two years in a row. Visit our website to learn more about our benefits and recognition within our communities.

We will make reasonable accommodation s to the known physical or mental limitation s of otherwise-qualified individuals with disabilities or special disabled veterans , unless the accommodation would impose an undue hardship on the operation of our business. Please email thebrightside@sunlife.com to request an accommodation.

For applicants residing in California, please read our employee California Privacy Policy and Notice.

We do not require or administer lie detector tests as a condition of employment or continued employment.

Sun Life will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including applicable fair chance ordinances.

*All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected vetera* n.

role.title: Sr. Engineering Program Director, Quality Strategy & Investigation Excellence
role.description:
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on - 9 Nov 2026 
 

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

**A Day in the Life**
=====================

Working closely with leaders across Quality, Engineering, Manufacturing, R&D, Clinical, Regulatory, Supply Chain, Customer Experience, and Digital organizations globally, you will establish and scale capabilities in root cause investigation, reliability engineering, advanced analytics, and quality intelligence. You will play a key role in driving investigation excellence, accelerating problem resolution, improving CAPA effectiveness, and enabling a more predictive and proactive quality organization. This role requires a leader who can influence across organizational boundaries, develop technical capability, and guide the resolution of the most complex quality and reliability challenges facing the business. The role aligns with the organization's vision of connecting customer experience, field performance, analytics, reliability, and quality intelligence to improve business decisions and quality outcomes.
 
 
As Senior Director, Quality Strategy & Investigation Excellence, you will be accountable for building and sustaining capabilities across Reliability Engineering, Statistics & Analytics, and Root Cause Excellence. You will lead multiple strategic workstreams including investigation methodology, Quality Reliability Engineering capability development, advanced analytical approaches, and critical quality event support. You will partner across a global matrix to strengthen investigation effectiveness, improve organizational learning, and ensure quality decisions are increasingly data-driven, risk-based, and customer-focused. This role requires a leader who can balance strategy and execution, coach technical experts, align stakeholders, and build long-term organizational capability. 

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned.

* Establish and lead a centralized Investigation Excellence Engineering capability.
* Develop organizational strategy for Root Cause Analysis and advanced quality analytics.
* Lead the deployment and governance of advanced investigation methodologies, including: Shainin Red X, Lean Six-Sigma, and other structured problem-solving approaches.
* Own escalation support for critical investigations, major quality events, recalls, and CAPAs.
* Build communities of practice and technical career pathways for Quality Reliability Engineers.
* Develop and mentor technical experts in investigation disciplines.
* Establish standards for investigation quality, analytical rigor, and root cause determination.
* Partner with Quality, Engineering, Manufacturing, and R&D leaders to proactively identify emerging signals and improve product performance.
* Advance the organization's transition toward predictive, data-driven, and proactive quality management.
* Plans, directs and implements all aspects of the company's design and development of new medical device products or software systems.
* May develop, evaluate, implement and maintain technical quality assurance and control systems or reliability systems and standards pertaining to materials, techniques, or company products.
* Oversees the investigation and evaluation of existing technologies.
* Guides the conceptualization of new methodologies, materials, machines, processes or products.
* Directs the development of new concepts from initial design to market release.
* Manages feasibility studies of the design to determine if capable of functioning as intended.
* Monitors documentation maintenance throughout all phases of research and development.
* Organizes the coordination of activities with outside suppliers and consultants to ensure timely delivery.
Selects, develops and evaluates personnel to ensure the efficient operation of the function. 

**PROGRAM MANAGEMENT CAREER STREAM:** Program Managers and Directors focus on tactical, operational activities for a major program with broad or ongoing impact. Levels within the program management career stream typically accomplish program objectives through matrixed employee teams and / or vendors who are not direct reports but for which the incumbent has direct accountability to lead. The majority of time is spent overseeing their area of responsibility, managing program/team performance, communicating project and operational developments, planning, prioritizing and / or directing the responsibilities of program team members. Goal achievement is typically accomplished through performance of program team members.

**DIFFERENTIATING FACTORS**

**Autonomy:** Manages multiple major, strategic programs and initiatives across the organization that require strong influence outside of immediate program stakeholders. Is accountable for overall program portfolio success. Assesses business strategy and recommends new programs or program changes.

**Organizational Impact:** Establishes program portfolio objectives, timelines, milestones, and budgets for multiple interconnected programs. Identifies business need and establishes new policies and procedures that affect program management. Has budget accountability for one or more strategic programs. Program decisions are made independently with strategic or costly decisions recommended to higher level management.

**Innovation and Complexity:** Problems and issues faced are complex, undefined and impact multiple businesses, functions or programs, where information is typically difficult to obtain and extensive investigation to understand the root cause of problems is required. Responsible for changing or improving upon entire processes or systems using significant conceptualizing, reasoning and interpretation skills.

**Communication and Influence:** Communicates and conducts briefings with senior or executive leadership regarding new strategic program proposals and critical program outcomes. Serves as principal spokesperson for multiple programs, interacting with leaders and executives on highly significant matters . Influences across functions, businesses and with external stakeholders to gain support of strategic programs where there are competing objectives and perspectives .

**Leadership and Talent Management:** Leads a matrixed large unit that typically includes multiple teams led by Program Managers and/or vendors. Approves tasks and schedule necessary for successful program execution. Not directly responsible for hire or fire decisions and people management.

**Required Knowledge and Experience:** Requires advanced management and leadership knowledge to lead cross-department project teams or manage across multiple functions. Typically has mastery within a specific technical or broad expertise across multiple related disciplines. Requires a Baccalaureate degree (or for degrees earned outside of the United States, a degree which satisfies the requirements of 8 C.F.R. § 214.2(h)( 4)(iii)(A) and minimum of 15 years of relevant experience with 10+ years of managerial experience, or advanced degree with a minimum 13 years of relevant experience and 10+ years of managerial experience.

**Preferred Knowledge and Experience:**

* Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in Engineering, Reliability Engineering, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Data Science, Materials Science, or related discipline.
* Medical Device, Aerospace, Defense, Semiconductor, Automotive, Energy, or other high-reliability industry experience.
* Expertise in advanced root cause methodologies such as:
 + Shainin Red X
 + Fault Tree Analysis (FTA)
 + Apollo RCA
 + Event & Causal Factor Analysis
 + Physics of Failure
 + Reliability-Centered investigations
 + 6-Sigma
* Experience building or leading Reliability Engineering, Failure Analysis, Investigation Excellence, or Quality Intelligence organizations.
* Expertise in reliability methodologies including Weibull analysis, reliability growth, accelerated life testing, and reliability modeling.
* Expertise in advanced statistical methods including DOE, regression modeling, predictive analytics, Bayesian methods, and complex data interpretation.
* Experience deploying enterprise-wide technical training and certification programs.
* Experience developing communities of practice and technical career frameworks.
Formal certifications in Reliability Engineering, Six Sigma, Shainin Red X, Quality Engineering, Statistics, or related disciplines. 

 

For Baccalaureate degrees earned outside of the United States, a degree that satisfies the requirements of 8 C.F.R. § 214.2(h)(4)(iii)(A) is required.

**Physical Job Requirements**

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.

The physical demands described within the Responsibilities section of this job description are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. For Office Roles: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to be independently mobile. The employee is also required to interact with a computer, and communicate with peers and co-workers. Contact your manager or local HR to understand the Work Conditions and Physical requirements that may be specific to each role.

**U.S. Work Authorization & Sponsorship**

At Medtronic, we are committed to fostering an environment where employees can thrive and make a meaningful impact. In alignment with our enterprise-wide workforce planning approach, U.S. work authorization sponsorship (H-1B, TN, J, etc.) is offered exclusively for Principal-level roles and above, where specialized expertise aligns with long-term business needs. Roles below the Principal level require candidates to possess unrestricted U.S. work authorization at the time of hire and for the duration of employment.
‌

**Recruitment Fraud Alert**

We are aware of phishing scams targeting job seekers. Please keep the following in mind:

 

Apply only through official Medtronic channels. All legitimate Medtronic recruiting communications come from approved Medtronic platforms and official @medtronic.com email addresses.

 

Medtronic will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information (such as bank account or Social Security details) during early stages of the hiring process. Any such requests are not legitimate.

 

If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Medtronic, do not respond, click links, or open attachments.

 

If you have any questions, concerns regarding the authenticity of a communication alleged to have been made by or on behalf of Medtronic, please contact us immediately at AskHR@medtronic.com .
‌

**Benefits & Compensation**
===========================

**Medtronic offers a competitive Salary and flexible Benefits Package** 
A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values. We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help to create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every career and life stage.

Salary ranges for U.S (excl. PR) locations (USD):$223,200.00 - $334,800.00
‌ 
This position is eligible for a short-term incentive called the Medtronic Incentive Plan (MIP).The base salary range is applicable across the United States, excluding Puerto Rico and specific locations in California. The offered rate complies with federal and local regulations and may vary based on factors such as experience, certification/education, market conditions, and location. role.title: Sr. Director Operations Engineering - C&I
role.description:
**We believe power is a promise - a shared commitment to be there for others when it matters most.**
====================================================================================================

For more than 65 years, we've turned big ideas into solutions that help protect homes, strengthen businesses and build a more resilient, efficient, sustainable energy future.

Ready to Power a Smarter World with us?

**Sr Director, Operations Engineering**
=======================================

The Sr Director, Operations Engineering is responsible for leading the enterprise Operations Engineering function with a focus on New Product Launches, Operations Integrations, Product Moves, and Operations Standards. This role ensures that new products, newly integrated operations, and transferred products are launched and sustained in manufacturing safely, on time, at quality, and at target cost. Through the development and deployment of enterprise standards, best practices, and the Generac Fulfillment System (GFS), the Director drives consistent, world-class execution across the Order-to-Cash process (Plan, Source, Make, Deliver & Service). The role partners closely with Engineering, Advanced Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, HR, and Business Unit leadership, and supports Generac's global manufacturing portfolio.

**Major Responsibilities**
--------------------------

### **New Product Launches (NPI)**

* Lead and coordinate the successful launch of New Product Introductions (NPI) within operations, from early design involvement through production ramp and sustained performance.
* Ensure manufacturing readiness for new products, including process design, PFMEA, line layout, tooling, fixtures, work instructions, and capacity planning.
* Partner with Product Engineering to drive design for manufacturability and assembly so new products launch with optimal cost, quality, and delivery.
* Establish launch gates, readiness criteria, and success metrics, and hold cross-functional teams accountable to them.
* Lead and support the introduction of new and revised processes and technologies that support cost reduction and competitive advantage.

### **Operations Integrations**

* Lead the operational integration of new sites, acquisitions, and expanded capacity into the Generac manufacturing network, aligning processes, systems, and performance expectations.
* Lead and contribute to facility transformation, including layout, mixed-model lines, value stream design, and deployment of the Generac Fulfillment System (GFS).
* Assess integrated facilities, infrastructure systems, and technology against best-in-class capability and develop roadmaps to close gaps.
* Coordinate cross-functional collaboration with HR, Finance, Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, and senior leadership to ensure integrations meet business objectives.
* Incorporate workplace optimization, space planning, and long-term facility planning into integration plans.

### **Product Moves & Transfers**

* Lead the planning and execution of product moves and technology transfers between facilities and with external supply chain partners, ensuring continuity of supply, quality, and cost.
* Own and continuously improve the product transfer procedure, and support the Operations Product Transfer Steering Committee to ensure alignment and adherence to the procedure.
* Develop transfer plans that include capacity validation, equipment and tooling relocation, process validation, training, and inventory bridge strategies.
* Partner with Business Unit and Manufacturing Strategy leaders to support footprint, rebalancing, and new capacity decisions with sound operations engineering analysis.

### **Operations Standards**

* Develop with corporate Advanced Manufacturing, deploy, and sustain enterprise operations engineering standards, policies, procedures, and process documentation that drive consistent execution across all facilities.
* Drive significant contributions to the implementation of the Generac Fulfillment System (GFS) across the Order-to-Cash process.
* Develop and implement operating methodologies designed to maximize floor space utilization, asset uptime and utilization, eliminate waste, and reduce operating cost.
* Champion lean principles and continuous improvement, and ensure the ongoing success of process improvement initiatives.
* Establish and monitor KPIs to evaluate productivity, engineering output, launch performance, and facility efficiency, using data to drive improvement.
* Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and environmental standards, and incorporate sustainability and energy efficiency initiatives.

### **Project Management & Financial Stewardship**

* Drive and project manage major cost, quality, and delivery initiatives, with a strong focus on breakthrough process and technology improvements.
* Facilitate project flow through regular engagement with engineering, manufacturing, and other cross-functional teams, managing shifting priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Oversee capital projects related to launches, integrations, and product moves, and provide budgetary figures for future fiscal year planning.
* Manage the operations engineering budget and support reduction of the operating cost of each facility consistent with company objectives.

### **Leadership & Talent Development**

* Lead the Operations Engineering team, including project planning, technical guidance, and resource allocation across sites and initiatives.
* Select, coach, and develop a high-performing team of engineers and project managers, setting objectives that align with company strategy.
* Manage organizational talent through performance management, succession planning, and development, ensuring feedback is consistently delivered and performance is systematically improved.
* Provide guidance to cross-functional teams and leadership on key decisions related to investment in core manufacturing technologies, processes, and systems.

**Minimum Job Requirements**
----------------------------

* **Education:** Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, or Industrial) or Industrial Technology.
* **Work Experience:** 10+ years of related experience in Operations Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, and Production, including leading new product launches and product transfers.
* **Leadership Experience:** 5+ years of increasing responsibility for project and/or people management involving a broad range of operational technologies and processes.

**Knowledge / Skills / Abilities**
----------------------------------

* Strong knowledge of New Product Development, PFMEA, and operations engineering principles.
* Knowledge of lean principles, continuous improvement, and end-to-end supply chain principles.
* Experience operating in both high-mix, low-volume and high-volume, low-mix production environments.
* Ability to assess and manage end-to-end processes and to manage strategic and tactical issues by being hands-on.
* Ability to develop and deploy standards and best practices across multiple sites.
* Ability to attract, develop, and manage an impactful team.
* Demonstrated skills in problem solving, conflict resolution, and cross-functional collaboration.
* Excellent organizational, written, and oral communication skills, including the ability to influence senior leadership.
* Proven ability to prioritize multiple projects with shifting priorities and moving deadlines.
* Proficiency in a CAD platform (AutoCAD, SolidWorks, and/or ProE), MS Office, and ERP platforms.

**Preferred Job Requirements**
------------------------------

* Master's Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Industrial Engineering.
* Project Management certification (e.g., PMP).
* Experience deploying processes and standards at an enterprise level, both internally and with external supply chain partners.
* Experience leading operations integrations, facility transformations, and multi-site product transfers.
* Experience working in an international company and in matrix organizations, with multi-site support experience.
* Previous experience using SAP or an equivalent ERP.
* Experience with facilities engineering and with using and/or implementing CMMS systems.
* Large-scale project management experience.

role.description:
The Director of Operations is responsible for supporting the mission, vision and values of First Watch through all that he/she does in their role every day. The DO’s primary purpose is to develop General Managers and restaurant management teams to build and increase sales over the previous year and improve profitability, while ensuring employee and guest satisfaction, without compromising the integrity or You First culture of the concept. The Director of Operations is responsible for the success of all First Watch operations within their span of control (5-8 direct reports and 200-300 employees).

**Job Responsibilities**

* Leads operational activities for a group of First Watch Restaurants by performing the following in accordance with Company guidelines regarding management development, sales, and profitability, planning and customer and employee relations
* Trains, coaches and develops General Managers and Operations Managers, through timely performance and observation feedback and evaluations
* Follows up on training of MIT's/CAFE’s and hourly employees. Works closely with the Training General Manager to monitor progress
* Ensures development of Operations Managers within compliance of the FW management development programs
* Through effective manpower planning executes the continuous development of the management team and ensures timely and cost effective recruitment of restaurant level management and their training within First Watch
* Ensures the maintenance of a safe and harassment free workplace in all restaurants
* Takes quick and responsible action in solving problems and able to uses reason when dealing with individual or staff performance based issues to include personality conflicts
* Develops for prior approval and then meets or exceeds the area’s budget, including capital investments, General and Administrative expenses
* Promotes First Watch outside the restaurant

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent – concentration in food & beverage, business, marketing or management is preferred
* Five to seven years of progressive leadership experience in multi unit restaurant industry operations
* Proven track record of achieving results and building & maintaining successful teams
* Passion for providing excellent service and quality
* Ability to partner and build relationships while demonstrating leadership and integrity and promoting team success
* Extensive knowledge of the principles, procedures, and best practices in the industry
* Ability to work well under pressure in a fast paced, dynamic environment
* Valid driver's license and ability to travel frequently within assigned market

* Ability to forecast and analyze business trends to maximize territory performance and profitability
* Ability to create and maintain a budget
* Travel within the required territory (5 days in the field)

Job Summary:

This role serves as a cross-functional operational leader, working collaboratively across the organization to define, optimize, and standardize business processes and operating procedures. It involves partnering with system end-users to design efficient workflows, implement cross-functional process improvements, and documenting operational policies. The role actively contributes to system and operational enhancement efforts by collaborating with Product, Technology, and Clinical leadership, ensuring technology is effectively leveraged to support business needs. It requires strong leadership, communication, and negotiation skills to influence operations across departments, foresee enterprise-level implications of changes, and manage risks and issues through resolution. With strong organizational and time management abilities, this individual provides operational expertise to market leadership, supports execution of P&L goals, and serves as a subject matter expert and guide to peers and teams across the enterprise.

Salary Range: $110,000 - $175,088

Job Description:

* Dyad partner to the CMD bringing together operational and clinical excellence to lead the community.
* Work collaboratively across the business to define, optimize, and evolve standard operating procedures and business process standardization across the enterprise
* Work with system/technology end-users to develop optimal system workflows to enable desired business process; Identify and implement cross-functional process improvements
* Document operational policies and procedures
* Working collaboratively with Product leadership, leverage understanding of business process to participate in future requirements gathering for system or operational enhancements or selection, across the enterprise
* Collaborate with Product, Technology and Clinical leadership to optimize and maximize use of selected technology
* Lead, persuade, influence, and negotiate with respect to market operations, as well as within Operations Department and among other supporting departments
* Understand and foresee enterprise/company implications of subtle detail changes
* Track issues/risks and follow through on resolution with departmental leads; Strong verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills, including demonstrated ability to communicate effectively and tactfully to internal and external stakeholders
* Possess highly effective time management and organizational skills to independently manage self to achieve multiple objectives and meet deadlines
* Work and collaborate effectively within a team environment; Contribute to organization’s growth and profitability by providing operational expertise to market leadership
* Serve in a leadership role, providing subject matter expertise, guidance, and direction to team and peers.
* For P&L, remains consulted and informed and is responsible for executing against the goals and targets.

role.title: Director, Operations
role.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing! 
We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Does the thought of joining one of the fastest-growing, privately held data center companies sound exciting to you? Do you enjoy collaborating with team members to drive and operate some of the industry’s leading and most innovative infrastructure solutions?

At **Aligned Data Centers**, not only do we celebrate success across our platform, we celebrate the very teams that drive and support that success! Our culture is founded in passion, engineered from innovation, and driven by the pursuit of operational excellence. We are a company dedicated to driving positive change in the industry through continuous data center innovation, diversity and inclusion, and corporate sustainability.

We realize not only is providing a comprehensive benefits package important, but we also provide a generous 401k match with immediate vesting, free membership to Gympass which provides our employees a rich health and wellness benefit and competitive time off plan. Giving back and having fun is important to our team whether it be serving our communities or employee and customer events. ***Our Aligned DNA is what makes us unique and successful!***

**JOB DESCRIPTION:**

The Director Operations is responsible for leading and executing all aspects of the campus operations to include safety, security, reliability, network environment, customer relations, the critical environment, and P&L. This role will strategize, manage, and operate multiple Datacenter facilities for Aligned. 
The Director of Operations will ensure all Datacenter facility systems meet or exceed industry standards for critical maintenance resulting in 100% uptime, ensures the building engineering and security teams follow all reporting and documentation processes and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and meets all customer service level agreements and compliance audits. The Director of Operations will serve as the liaison for all 24x7 operational activities across their managed facilities with executives and department heads to ensure appropriate communications with all interested and vested parties. They will lead and direct the staff in their market to optimize employee potential and maximize Aligned’s continued growth in existing and new markets. This role reports to the SVP of Operations or their designee.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Provides senior leadership to drive strategic vision for Aligned’s datacenters, including Critical Facilities Operations, Preventative Maintenance, Commissioning, Infrastructure, Service Delivery, Security, Logistics, and Safety on a Senior level.
* Manages Campus operations of the 24x7 Datacenter environment. Identifies and implements critical metrics necessary to manage and monitor the performance of overall operations including, but not limited to, capacity, availability, budget, and inventory. Oversees all electrical and mechanical infrastructure such as UPS systems, generators, fire suppression systems, BMS, and HVAC systems Has responsibility for meeting established Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Ensures that all work performed within the Datacenter is done to high quality and without impact to any internal/external customers.
* Oversees requirements and delivery of services provided by Operations, Security, and Safety. Drives maximum potential of these functions to provide exceptional services to clients and employees.
* Oversees and supports the level 5 commissioning, operations, and maintenance of all Datacenter mission critical infrastructure in order to achieve 100% availability. Manages Datacenter facility expansion and consolidation.
* Manages, coaches, and develops management team performing Datacenter operations.
* Manages and leads vendor relationship to maintain day to day operations and strategic goals for Datacenter Operations SLA’s and deliverables. Works with current vendor stakeholders and partners to develop and deliver strategic plans. Oversees all Datacenter vendor contracts, streamlining services required and optimizing overall costs.
* Will work closely with all strategic supply chain vendors to ensure Aligned’s lean management strategies and continuous innovation and process improvement are fully implemented.
* Evaluates and mitigates risk on new and existing programs within datacenter program governance.
* Develops opportunities for cross-team effectiveness and remove organizational barriers for strong teamwork, collaboration, and excellent service delivery.
* Drives Aligned’s Sustainability Strategy and creates a program to improve the efficiency of the Datacenter operations.
* Engages in improvement projects, which often requires reaching out to a variety of support teams and driving them from conception to completion.
* Manages budgeting and forecasting, planning, deployment, incident and problem management, change management.
* Maintains documentation and diagrams capturing all essential parameters of Datacenter operations.
* Defines policies, procedures, and standards related to performance, capacity, availability, continuity, and security.
* Creates and delivers presentations to leadership team, company meetings, and conferences.
* Will meet all customer service levels and power utilization efficiency commitments and take an active role in on-going customer interaction. Participate in customer service review discussion and various ad-hoc meetings related to Datacenter management issues.
* Manages customer service orders and remote hand requests.
* Supervise local change management processes including the review and approval of all Method of Procedures (MOPs) for maintenance and one-time/emergency repair events in coordination with onsite personnel, contractors, and customers.
* Ensure compliance with all safety procedures as well as utilization of personal protective equipment (PPE).
* Respond quickly and appropriately to emergency situations (i.e., fire, evacuation, equipment failure etc.) and any customer concerns.

role.title: Director, Ops Analysis (R5036)
role.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 


Job Description:
Shield AI is building intelligent autonomy systems for the defense of service members and civilians. The Hivemind Solutions organization applies Shield AI’s autonomy stack to mission-critical systems across air, maritime, strike, weapons, space, and collaborative autonomy domains.
We are seeking a Director, Operations Analysis to lead a team responsible for turning operational problems into quantitative insights that shape product strategy, engineering priorities, customer engagement, and mission outcomes. This leader will manage and grow a high-performing Operations Analysis team that uses modeling, simulation, wargaming, campaign analysis, and mission-level trade studies to help determine what Hivemind should build, why it matters, and how it performs in realistic operational contexts.
This is a leadership role for someone who can operate at the intersection of autonomy, military operations, mission engineering, modeling and simulation, product strategy, and customer-facing analysis. The right candidate will be technically credible, analytically rigorous, comfortable with ambiguity, and able to translate complex operational questions into clear recommendations for executives, engineers, business development leaders, and government customers.

What you'll do:: 

 Lead and manage the Hivemind Solutions Operations Analysis team, including hiring, mentoring, prioritization, performance management, and technical direction.

 Build an operations analysis capability that directly informs Hivemind product strategy, autonomy roadmap decisions, customer pursuits, and program execution.

 Define and execute mission analysis, campaign analysis, force-on-force studies, CONOPS evaluations, and operational trade studies across multiple Hivemind product domains.

 Partner with Product, Architecture, Systems Engineering, Business Development, Strategy, and Program teams to translate operational problems into analytical studies and actionable product recommendations.

 Develop analysis plans that connect mission objectives, operational assumptions, threat environments, system performance, autonomy behaviors, and measurable mission outcomes.

 Guide the use of tools such as AFSIM, NGTS, STK, MATLAB, Python, custom simulations, and other modeling environments to evaluate mission effectiveness and operational value.

 Establish standards for analytical rigor, model credibility, assumption tracking, sensitivity analysis, uncertainty characterization, and communication of results.

 Create clear, executive-ready briefings that explain what was analyzed, what assumptions were made, what the results mean, and what decisions should follow.

 Support customer engagements by developing compelling, technically grounded analysis that demonstrates the operational value of Hivemind-enabled systems.

 Work with engineering teams to identify the autonomy behaviors, system capabilities, interfaces, performance parameters, and test data needed to improve model fidelity.

 Help shape product requirements by connecting operational outcomes to measurable system and autonomy performance needs.

 Build reusable analysis frameworks, scenarios, vignettes, and metrics that can scale across programs and domains.

 Represent the Operations Analysis function in internal technical reviews, roadmap discussions, capture strategy sessions, and customer-facing meetings.




Required qualifications:: 

 Bachelor’s degree in engineering, operations research, applied mathematics, computer science, physics, aerospace, systems engineering, data science, or a related technical field.

 10+ years of relevant experience in operations analysis, mission analysis, modeling and simulation, systems analysis, military analysis, campaign analysis, or related technical domains.

 5+ years of experience leading teams, projects, or technical analysis efforts.

 Experience using modeling and simulation to inform real product, system, program, or operational decisions.

 Strong understanding of military operations, mission planning, force employment, kill chains, sensing, communications, autonomy, aircraft systems, weapons systems, or related defense concepts.

 Ability to translate ambiguous operational questions into structured analysis plans, quantitative methods, and decision-quality outputs.

 Experience working with engineering, product, business development, strategy, or customer-facing teams.

 Strong technical communication skills, including the ability to brief senior leaders and customers with clarity, confidence, and analytical discipline.

 Ability to work in a fast-paced environment where priorities evolve quickly and analysis must support real business and technical decisions.

 U.S. citizenship and eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance.




Preferred qualifications:: 

 Master’s degree or PhD in operations research, engineering, applied mathematics, data science, aerospace, systems engineering, or a related technical field.

 Experience with AFSIM, NGTS, STK, MATLAB, Python, Cameo, custom simulation environments, or other mission and campaign analysis tools.

 Experience analyzing autonomous systems, collaborative autonomy, uncrewed aircraft, crewed-uncrewed teaming, electronic warfare, space systems, missile systems, maritime systems, or air combat operations.

 Experience supporting defense product development, advanced concepts, government capture efforts, experimentation, test planning, or mission engineering.

 Familiarity with model validation, verification, credibility assessment, sensitivity analysis, design of experiments, and uncertainty quantification.

 Experience building analysis teams, establishing technical standards, and scaling analytical capabilities across multiple stakeholders or product lines.

 Prior military, government laboratory, FFRDC/UARC, defense contractor, or aerospace experience.

 Active U.S. security clearance.




What success looks like:: 
 In this role, success means the Operations Analysis team becomes a trusted decision engine for Hivemind Solutions. The team’s work should not sit on a shelf. It should shape what we build, how we prioritize, how we explain operational value to customers, and how we make hard trade decisions across product lines.

 A successful manager will build a team that is technically rigorous, operationally grounded, fast-moving, and deeply connected to the business. They will ensure that analysis is not treated as an after-the-fact briefing function, but as a core part of product development, strategy, and customer engagement.



Why this role matters:: 
 Autonomy changes what is operationally possible, but only if we understand where it creates real mission advantage. The Operations Analysis team helps answer that question. This team connects Hivemind’s technical capabilities to measurable operational outcomes, helping Shield AI make better product decisions and helping customers understand the mission impact of intelligent autonomous systems.

 If you want to lead a team that sits at the center of autonomy, strategy, engineering, and operational decision-making, this role is for you.

role.title: Vice President of Operations
role.description:
Quindar builds software to manage satellites like servers. We are seeking a Vice President of Operations to build the operating system, organizational infrastructure, and business processes that turn company strategy into execution as we scale across commercial and government markets.
 This leader owns business operations, strategy and performance, facilities, and General & Administrative functions. Beyond running the operating cadence, the role connects corporate strategy, resource allocation, and cross-functional execution so that Quindar consistently makes the right investments and turns them into business outcomes. The role holds the authority to resolve cross-functional prioritization conflicts at the leadership level, with clear and intentional escalation to the CEO, while functional leaders retain accountability for their results and authority over their teams.
 Facilities, Business Operations, and the G&A team report to this role, with their leaders responsible for day-to-day execution. This is a hands-on executive role for someone who can build a function, develop its leaders, and drive execution across the company.
 
 Company Execution and Performance Management 
 • Translate company strategy into company OKRs and functional commitments with accountable owners, deadlines, dependencies, and approved resources.
 • Agree with each functional leader on a small set of meaningful KPIs with clear definitions, source data, targets, and reporting frequency, and maintain a consolidated performance dashboard across Sales, Product, Engineering, Programs, Finance, People and Brand, and Operations.
 • Design and run the company operating model: quarterly planning, leadership reviews, decision tracking, and follow-up, with a visible record of commitments delivered, missed, corrected, and rescoped.
 • Design and implement a company-wide model for cross-functional prioritization and decision-making at the leadership level, including decision rights and escalation paths, aligned with and actively reinforced by the CEO.
 • Use the operating data to drive decisions and corrective actions, resolve cross-functional dependencies, and escalate decisions that put company goals at risk.
 • Partner with functional leaders and the VP of Finance to align workforce capacity, hiring plans, facilities, and budgets with company priorities.
 
 Corporate Strategy and Go-to-Market 
 • Help shape corporate strategy with the CEO and leadership team, including evaluating markets and opportunities, defining investment requirements, and translating strategic choices into resourced plans.
 • Lead the cross-functional planning and execution of GTM priorities in partnership with the CEO, who leads Sales & Marketing: align Product, Engineering, Programs, and Operations behind revenue priorities and ensure the organization is resourced to deliver them.
 • Lead the evaluation and incubation of new business opportunities, including, but not limited to,Operations as a Service (OaaS). For OaaS, lead the initial cross-functional effort to take the offering from concept toward launch, including the business model, service definition and commercial terms, investment requirements, and operational readiness.
 • Ensure new services, markets, and programs are integrated into company planning, performance management, and compliance from the outset.
 
 AI-Enabled Business Operations 
 • Lead the AI Business Operations team to build and deploy workflows that reduce manual coordination and increase output across Quindar, with measurable reductions in hands-on processing time and sustained adoption.
 • Identify and baseline the highest-value workflows across functions, prioritizing those that remove coordination overhead between Product, Engineering, Programs, Sales, and Marketing (for example, specifications to engineering tickets, user documentation, marketing materials, and proposal development).
 • Build internal knowledge infrastructure, such as a company data warehouse of product knowledge, engineering designs, documentation, and marketing and proposal content, that any role can query or use to create collateral through an agentic interface.
 • Implement appropriate access controls, source traceability, and compliance requirements, including CUI handling, before any workflow handling sensitive or consequential outputs enters production use.
 
 Facilities and Classified Readiness 
 • Own facilities planning, buildouts, workplace operations, vendor management, and procurement across all unclassified and classified spaces.
 • Maintain an integrated master schedule covering construction, procurement, vendors, budget, and readiness for each space, with a defined risk and impact scale, reviewed regularly with the CEO.
 • Deliver the facilities infrastructure needed for classified readiness, completing facilities work ahead of accreditation target dates and obtaining Security’s written acceptance against an agreed readiness checklist.
 • Partner with Security, IT, Contracts, and program leadership so that facilities, policies, training, and records support classified program and audit requirements. Security retains accreditation responsibility.
 
 General and Administrative Operations 
 • Lead legal operations, and corporate administrative services through internal teams and outside partners.
 • Manage outside counsel and coordinate corporate legal matters, employment matters, contract review, and company policies.
 • Own cap table and stock option administration in partnership with Finance and legal counsel, and maintain corporate records and board and stockholder approval workflows with the CEO and counsel.
 • Own the administrative infrastructure required to pursue and support government business, including SAM.gov registration, applicable NSTXL and consortium memberships, JCP certification/DD Form 2345, and a centralized calendar of registrations, renewals, and reporting obligations.
 • Oversee export compliance program administration, including applicable ITAR/EAR processes, working with qualified counsel and designated compliance personnel.
 • Coordinate corporate insurance, business continuity planning, corporate overhead efficiency, and company-wide operational risk management.
 
 Fundraising and Finance Partnership 
 • Lead operational, legal, people, and corporate diligence readiness for fundraising alongside the VP of Finance, including an organized data room and timely, accurate responses to investor requests.
 • Support board materials and investor reporting with company operating metrics, organizational plans, and progress against strategic priorities.
 • Partner with Finance on operating plans, overhead budgets, and the investments needed to support the next stage of growth and new business lines.
 
 Qualifications 
 • Experience leading operations at a growing technology company, with exposure to government contracting or another regulated market.
 • Demonstrated success building teams, systems, and operating processes through a significant stage of organizational growth.
 • Experience contributing to corporate strategy and leading cross-functional GTM or new-business initiatives from concept to launch, with a bias toward revenue and business outcomes.
 • Experience across facilities, legal operations, compliance, or business operations.
 • A hands-on track record of using AI, technology, and automation to improve operational efficiency.
 • Familiarity with venture-backed company governance, equity administration, and fundraising diligence.
 • Ability to turn ambiguous priorities into clear plans, coordinate executive peers, and hold teams accountable for commitments.
 • Strong judgment about when to act directly, delegate, escalate, or engage specialist expertise.
 
 What Success Looks Like 
 • Company strategy is reflected in OKRs, KPIs, and commitments with clear owners, and leaders run the business from a trusted, shared dashboard.
 • Cross-functional prioritization decisions are made quickly and consistently at the leadership level, with less day-to-day intervention from the CEO.
 • GTM priorities and new services such as OaaS move from strategy to resourced, cross-functionally executed plans with measurable revenue impact.
 • AI-enabled workflows are in production across functions, materially reducing manual coordination while meeting access-control and compliance requirements.
 • Facilities for classified operations are delivered on schedule and accepted by Security.
 • Organizational structures, career frameworks, equity programs, and scaling processes are ready ahead of growth to 150+ employees.
 • Required registrations, compliance obligations, and corporate and equity records remain current and diligence-ready.
 
 Security Clearance Eligibility Requirement 
Due to U.S. Government contractual requirements, this position requires eligibility for a U.S. Government security clearance. U.S. citizenship is required to obtain a security clearance; therefore, candidates for this position must be U.S. citizens. An active clearance is not required at the time of hire but is preferred and may be required in the future based on program needs.
 
 ITAR REQUIREMENTS 
 To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here .

 Why you'll love working at Quindar
 We work in a cutting edge industry and you will get the opportunity to be part of a small team with a large direct impact on the success of our customers’ space missions!

 We take work life balance very seriously. We require employees to take 15 days off but provide unlimited PTO and follow most US federal government holidays.

 Mental health is just as important as physical so we provide quarterly health & wellness benefits.

 Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family with 100% coverage for employees.

 We encourage employees to save for retirement and provide 4% 401(k) matching.

 Each quarter we have a 4-day company offsite. Previous locations include San Francisco, Nashville, Denver, Santa Fe, New Orleans, San Diego, Bozeman, and New York City.

 Our culture and company is evolving. You will be key in creating the next major or minor version!

role.title: Head of Operations Planning and Special Projects
role.description:
Join the team bringing autonomy to the built world

 At Bedrock, we're moving AI out of the lab and onto real job sites. Our team includes veterans who helped launch Waymo, scaled Segment to a $3.2B acquisition, and grew Uber Freight to $5B in revenue. We retrofit the heavy equipment contractors already own, starting with excavators, so experienced crews can safely take on more projects and deliver more of the critical infrastructure our society needs.

In August 2026, Bedrock-equipped excavators began doing fully autonomous, paid work on live commercial job sites. We've more than doubled our customer base since 2025, and our machines now work with contractors across the South, Midwest, and Mid-Atlantic

In October 2026, we raised a $600M Series C co-led by CapitalG and Emergence Capital, bringing our total funding to nearly $1B. We're using it to put more autonomous machines to work, build the field and operations teams behind every deployment, and expand into new machine types and job-site tasks.

This is where algorithms meet steel-toed boots. You'll work alongside construction veterans and world-class engineers to solve physical-world problems that simulations can't touch. If you're ready to do meaningful work on hard problems, we'd love to have you join us.
 About the role
 Bedrock's technology is scaling rapidly —over the next twelve months, we will rapidly scale our machine count, partners, and sites while also adding net-new machine types and a next-generation platform. 
 The Head of Operations Planning & Special Projects owns aligning cross-functionally on an integrated machine plan across types, generations, product lines, partners, sites in order to develop Operational headcount and material plans; ultimately, giving the business a clear view of what's required and by when. 
 You'll own the integrated machine plan, scenario planning, cross-functional alignment when constraints arise, building headcount scaling factors and plans, and standing up our early Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process. Reporting to the VP of Operations, you'll be a critical thought partner to the VP and each Operations Lead.
 What you'll do
 Integrated Planning
 Own the integrated operations plan covering requirements across all product lines, machines, field headcount, and material readiness.

 Identify constraints in the plan and build scenarios that drive resolution or acceptable alternatives.

 Partner with each Operations leader to surface optimizations, risks, and constraints, and develop paths to mitigation.

 Support senior leadership and board-level decisions with clear, rigorous analysis.

 Partner with the VP of Operations to define team OKRs, the mechanisms to track them, and routine reporting on critical initiatives.

 Contribute to the long-term forecast, integrating priorities across multiple teams.

 Help align data collection needs with operational optimizations to strengthen our data pipelines.

 S&OP Process Implementation
 Partner with Commercial, Finance, Supply Chain, Engineering, and Operations to build stage-appropriate S&OP processes that tee up critical business decisions, surface constraints, and evaluate alternatives.

role.title: Staff Manufacturing Engineer, Primary Structures
role.description:
At Relativity Space, we’re building rockets to serve today’s needs and tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that’s just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known. 

 Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven’t been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you’re in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you’ll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we’re writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it’s early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us. 

 About the Team:  

 The Stage Manufacturing team turns design into reality, owning the build of Terran R’s primary structures. This isn’t about turning the same bolt every day; it’s about building the systems to build the rocket. Engineers and technicians work side by side, with deep collaboration and real-time feedback, to shape how we build better and faster. With a manifest and a launch date, it’s up to the team to deliver on Terran R: solving challenges in real time, optimizing for scale, and constantly improving processes. As the vehicle evolves, so will the factory, with opportunities to apply automation, machine learning, and advanced technologies. What we build here sets the blueprint for the future of scaled launch.   

 About the Role: 

 
 Provide Design for Manufacturing feedback to structures teams during the development phase and through the first prototype and flight builds. 

 Collaborate closely with a diverse team of engineers specializing in design, manufacturing, and reliability, as well as internal production teams and external vendors, leveraging their collective expertise to drive progress.  

 Cover the shop floor for all primary structure work center assembly work, clearing barriers and keeping production moving. 

 Champion process improvements across multiple work centers to improve assembly operations and incorporate feedback and learnings from the first Terran R build  

 Create work instructions, specifications, and best practices across multiple high-fidelity processes. Help standardize processes across the manufacturing team 

 
 About You: 

 
 Bachelor’s degree in manufacturing, aeronautical, mechanical engineering, or other engineering discipline  

 8+ years progressive and related experience required 

 Strong history of supporting complicated assembly builds and capable of making risk decisions on a regular basis to disposition issues during build and keep production moving 

 Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to interface with engineering and manufacturing groups to understand process constraints and provide design inputs for improved manufacturability  

 Strong engineering fundamentals in statics, mechanics of materials, process improvement/factory design, fastening and joining, machining.   

 Expert knowledge of common drilling and trim ops, other manufacturing processes, tools, inspection methods and GD&T 

 
 Nice to haves but not required:    

 
 Direct experience with forming, welding, drill, trim and fastening operations for aerospace products 

 New product introduction of an aerospace hardware system into a manufacturing, test, and production system with proven success 

 Experience in managing projects in a fast-paced environment
